about: TAPEWARD prizes (BRIEF change log 19-10-2026). Single source of truth for the prize wallet, budgets, splits and payout rules.
funding: seed from the founder; after T0, 5 % of the token's Pons creator fees (top-ups sent by the founder, every inbound transfer listed)
tokens_note: RC stock tokens verified on chain 19-10-2026 with symbol() + decimals(). Tokens of COIN, PLTR, USAR, TSM, ASML, BABA, EWY are not listed (address not verified): the wallet may hold them but they are ignored (not valued, not paid).
rules: Free to play: top callers of a round win stock tokens from the prize wallet.
Daily round: 4 % of the prize wallet's USD value at lock, split 50/30/20 among the top 3 (no prize when that is below $1).
ELECTION-2026: 40 % of the prize wallet's USD value at lock, paid after the Day one settle to the top 10 (25/18/14/11/9/7/6/4/3/3 %).
Paid in the winning basket's stock tokens when the wallet holds them (largest holding first), otherwise in ETH.
The house desk never wins. Ties: earlier signature. A prize needs a wallet with at least one earlier transaction on Robinhood Chain when the pick was made.
After launch, holders get prize weight x2 (non-holders can still win). Payouts under $0.10 stay in the wallet for the next round.
